sources.title: GitHub - futuresun912/HyperPrune
sources.snippet: OpenReview HyperPrune trains a small shared hypernetwork that learns the 2:4 semi-structured sparsity pattern for every linear projection in a LLaMA-family transformer. The hypernetwork sees one group of four weights at a time, conditions on layer / component context, and outputs a probability distribution over the C (4, 2) = 6 valid 2:4 masks.
